draft.about: Working file for the upgrade (core, WLC, servers, fire zones). Configs to be agreed before the final upgraded .pkt.

as-is.about: The network as it is today: only devices seen on site, plus clearly labelled assumptions for what we could not see (closet, campus gateway, controller). One flat VLAN, one subnet.

fire-demo.about: Fast demo of fire scenario S1: same configs as the draft, only the core, the alert server and all three 2F fire zones (202-217, 220-232, Conference Room). Open it, wait ~30 s, Physical > 2F, Alt+click the fire source.

as_is_assumptions: Network closet not accessible: one closet switch (W19-CLOSET-SW) is assumed to connect every hub and access switch.
Routing and DHCP are done by the campus network: modelled as WSU-CAMPUS-GW with one flat subnet 172.19.0.0/22 (addressing assumed).
The Cisco APs are lightweight, so a campus wireless controller must exist: modelled as WSU-WLC.
Everything (PCs, APs, staff, students) shares VLAN 1 - no segmentation, no QoS.
Smoke detectors are conventional (stand-alone), not on the IP network.
